claims.head: Montréal’s shot quality meets a soft spot
claims.body: Montréal ranks 2nd of 32 for shot quality (one expected goal for every 14.5 unblocked shots); Washington ranks 28th of 32 for keeping shots to the outside.

claims.head: Opposite ends on point-shot reliance
claims.body: Washington ranks 5th of 32 for point-shot reliance, toward the point-heavy end; Montréal ranks 24th, toward the down low end.
